# Both engines must take the pipelined "Data could not be sent to remote
# host" lead (SSHUnreachableMsg): the issue's transcript has it, and the
# harness replaces the environment wholesale, so the option has to be
# stated here instead of inherited from the invoking shell. It also puts
# the delegate's connection host INTO the msg, which is what this issue's
# fix pins.
ANSIBLE_PIPELINING=True
